**Note · 2026-11-24T08:1xZ** (maintainer, bug-discussion thread; decision card 06:36Z 「全部按建议」). Scope unchanged; two pointers from the new Studio epic **#36890**:

1. The Studio landing page (`/studio` package cards) will be removed by **#36908** after this card merges (decision 9). Item 3 here ("Studio is unchanged: its 'All packages' link…") holds until then; #36908 moves those doors.
2. "After create, go straight into Studio": Studio's top-left back link remembers the last app page, which would be Setup. Epic decision 5/6 says Studio shows the current package's app name, and #36906 resolves "which app" by the current package first. Nothing to change here; just do not rely on the remembered app in this card.
